article_title: Are you an evening snacker? What you need to know

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why evening cravings occur, how late snacking may affect health and sleep, and practical ways to manage it
Why everyone should avoid eating after midday
A new medicine that permanently removes hunger
Why breakfast causes poor sleep
tasks.correct_answer: Why evening cravings occur, how late snacking may affect health and sleep, and practical ways to manage it
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה מדוע חשק לנשנוש מתגבר בערב, מה ידוע על השפעותיו, ואילו הרגלים יכולים לעזור.

tasks.prompt: What happens to the hunger hormone ghrelin later in the day, according to Prof James Betts?
options: It disappears after lunch.
It is generally higher later in the day.
It is produced only during sleep.
It is permanently suppressed by dinner.
tasks.correct_answer: It is generally higher later in the day.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי פרופ' בטס, רמת הורמון הרעב גרלין בדרך כלל גבוהה יותר בשעות המאוחרות של היום.

tasks.prompt: What does “satiating” mean when describing an evening meal?
options: Very sweet
Quick to prepare
Able to make you feel full and satisfied
Eaten while watching television
tasks.correct_answer: Able to make you feel full and satisfied
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Satiating מתאר מזון שמשביע ומשאיר תחושת מלאות לזמן ארוך יותר.

tasks.prompt: How can watching television trigger snacking?
options: Television lowers blood sugar immediately.
Every programme contains food advertising.
The screen changes ghrelin into sugar.
Repeatedly snacking in that setting can turn the TV into a cue for cravings.
tasks.correct_answer: Repeatedly snacking in that setting can turn the TV into a cue for cravings.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר נשנוש חוזר באותה סביבה, עצם הדלקת הטלוויזיה יכולה להפוך לרמז שמעורר חשק לאכול.

tasks.prompt: What does the article say about whether evening snacking disrupts sleep?
options: The evidence is mixed and it is difficult to establish cause and effect.
Every snack always prevents sleep.
Only fruit has been proven to harm sleep.
Researchers agree that timing has no effect on anyone.
tasks.correct_answer: The evidence is mixed and it is difficult to establish cause and effect.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הראיות אינן חד־משמעיות, וקשה לדעת אם הנשנוש פוגע בשינה או ששינה גרועה מגבירה חשק למזונות עתירי אנרגיה.

tasks.prompt: What does “hedonic drive” mean in the article?
options: A medical need for protein
A plan to eat larger dinners
A desire for pleasurable food driven by the brain's reward system
A method for measuring sleep
tasks.correct_answer: A desire for pleasurable food driven by the brain's reward system
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Hedonic drive הוא דחף לאכול לשם הנאה, שמקורו במערכת התגמול ועלול להתגבר על אותות השובע.

tasks.prompt: Give three reasons why someone might snack in the evening even after dinner.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה גורמים שונים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Appetite and ghrelin naturally tend to be higher later in the day.
Dinner may not contain enough protein, fibre or volume to remain filling.
A person may fear waking up hungry during the night.
Habit and environmental cues, such as watching TV, can trigger cravings.
The brain's reward system increases desire for foods high in fat, sugar or salt.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article say evening snacking is not simply a failure of willpower?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין ביולוגיה, מערכת התגמול, הרגלים ורמזים סביבתיים.
expected_points: Hunger hormones and appetite often rise later in the day.
The brain's reward system increases wanting for calorie-dense foods.
Reward signals can override feelings of fullness.
Repeated routines create cues that trigger cravings automatically.
Sleep deprivation may also raise appetite and desire for energy-dense foods.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the causes, uncertain sleep evidence and practical advice in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול גורם ביולוגי, גורם התנהגותי, אי־הוודאות לגבי שינה ולפחות שתי המלצות.
expected_points: Evening appetite may rise because of ghrelin and the brain's reward response to rich foods.
Unfilling meals and habits such as eating while watching TV can also trigger cravings.
Research on late snacks and sleep is mixed, and cause and effect are difficult to separate.
More filling earlier meals and changes to routines can help.
Experts recommend reasonable portions and keeping fruit, yoghurt or nuts available rather than banning all treats.

tasks.prompt: Create a short personal plan for managing habitual evening snacking.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע תכנית מציאותית המבוססת על הכתבה, ללא איסורים קיצוניים או הבטחות רפואיות.
expected_points: Identify whether the trigger is genuine hunger, habit, distraction or fear of waking hungry.
Make dinner more filling with protein, fibre and volume if needed.
Change the usual cue or routine, such as not eating automatically while watching TV.
Plan a reasonable portion and keep healthier options available.
Allow occasional treats in moderation.
